# Generated by the shadcn CLI. Never hand-edit.

Overwritten on the next `shadcn add`. Only shadcn components belong here: no wrappers,
no helpers, no app-owned components. Those go in `src/components/` and `src/lib/`.

Biome skips this directory (`files.includes` in `biome.jsonc`, not `linter.includes`)
because `ultracite fix` corrupted `combobox.tsx` by duplicating a JSX attribute, and
the PostToolUse hook runs `fix` after every edit. A type error pointing in here means
biome touched a file: delete `src/components/ui` and `src/hooks` and regenerate, do not
hand-fix.

```bash
cd apps/web
yes '' | bunx --bun shadcn@latest add <name> --yes   # `yes ''` required, it prompts anyway
```

Do not run `shadcn init`. `components.json` is hand-authored and correct; init's
defaults are not.

To customize, in order: a token in `src/styles.css`, then a `[data-slot="..."]` rule
there, then a wrapper in `src/components/`. Example of the last:
`src/components/themed-toaster.tsx` overrides the generated Toaster's theme by passing
a prop, because it spreads `{...props}` last.
